metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a tar archive of the old_files directory. The evaluator searches for tar archives in expected locations and verifies they contain the old files. Similar to original compression task but uses tar archiving instead of file-by-file compression.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluation script checks for tar archives containing old_files in /tmp/test_files or /tmp directories

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses vm_command_line getter to execute verification script on VM
Metric function check_include_exclude properly handles expected.type='rule' and receives rules dict directly
Evaluation script searches in both specified locations (/tmp/test_files and /tmp) as per instruction
Archive existence check is robust: searches for various tar formats (*.tar*) and naming patterns
Archive content verification: script verifies archive contains old_files using tar -tf and grep
Complete coverage: checks both that archive exists AND contains correct content
